trigger: CREATE TRIGGER admission_applications_validate_branch_track BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF program_offering_id, track_id ON public.admission_applications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_admission_branch_track()

CREATE TRIGGER student_profiles_validate_branch_track BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF branch_id, track_id, program_offering_id, status ON public.student_profiles FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION validate_student_branch_track()
